name: junco-frontend
description: Live monitoring frontend for Junco graphs: an Express event server and React widgets.

scripts.build: bun build ./server/index.ts --outdir ./dist/server --target node --format esm --packages external --sourcemap=external && bun run tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build ./client/index.html --outdir ./dist/client --minify
scripts.typecheck: bun run tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json && bun run tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
